button.class: btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 ms-2 o_om_guided_all_hidden

div.span: Other buttons of the form and list

div.div: Shown: they see the button and can use it.

Hidden (dimmed): the button is not on the screen. They could still run the same action another way: from another screen, the Action menu or by calling Odoo directly. Use it to keep screens simple, not to forbid something.

Blocked (red, with the lock): hidden too, and Odoo refuses it however they try, with an error; each try is written to the audit log. Use it for what they must not do. Odoo's own automatic work (scheduled jobs, automations) still runs it.
